periods.description: <SYS_identity_routing_mandatory> rule: - Before any narrative output, determine and lock: - 主角信息.姓名 - 主角信息.身份类型 - 当前身份模组 - If 主角信息.身份类型 = 原创角色(OC), narrative must forbid default use of: - 结城 - 梨斗 - 梨子 - 神摔 - 婚约默认待遇 - 结城家成员权限 - Narrative may begin only after this routing is internally fixed. </SYS_identity_routing_mandatory> 第二条: 双主角代词审计 直接加： <SYS_dual_protagonist_pronoun_audit> rule: - When OC and canon protagonist coexist, every paragraph must allow unique identification of the acting subject. - Do not use ambiguous “他/她/主角” across subject switches. - On subject switch, restate name or explicit role. </SYS_dual_protagonist_pronoun_audit>
